title: Work — fourteen questions, fourteen answers
description: Case studies from The Miller Group: Gelson’s, Skirball, The Salvation Army, Goodwill, MOLAA, Centra, Johnson PetDor and more. Every number published, none invented.
kicker: Work · Fourteen engagements · Every number published
lede: Each engagement started as a question the client could not answer on their own. Here is what we found, what we made, and what happened next.
rationale: Order is proof-first: the seven cases with a published number or a hard outcome lead, the concept-only cases follow. The old /work/ page is a wall of 14 equal tiles with no numbers; a buyer scanning for “have they done this for someone like me?” gets industry filters instead of a scroll. Every case now has a real page — today they are 85–140-word Challenge/Solution blurbs.
